title: Sundial
page_desc: Clock for local protection. Quiet overnight, or guard a work shift. Not a packet injector.
status_desc: Live window, wanted state, and the last automatic actions.
schedule_desc: One window per plugin. Overnight ranges (22:00 → 07:00) are allowed.
week_desc: Sunday is first. Unchecked days are left alone.
device_desc: Read-only app settings that can fight this schedule.
arm_body: When off, Sundial never calls start or stop.
label: Window name
same_time: Start and end match — the window has zero length.
schedule_hint: quiet pauses protection inside the window. guard keeps it on only inside the window. Times use this phone’s clock.
policy_guard: guard — on only inside the window
notify_body: At most once every 30 seconds, eight per hour.
hold_body: One shot. Useful if you need protection during tonight’s quiet window.
poll_note: The clock ticks every 60 seconds (host maximum 120). Edges are not second-accurate.
run_hint: Apply now runs the same check as the minute timer. Start/stop is limited to once every 15 seconds.
disclaimer: Sundial only requests the same local start/stop as the Home screen. It is not a remote VPN and does not change DNS hosts or rules.
days_hint: Unchecked days are ignored. The schedule never fires on those weekdays.
disarmed_alert: Schedule is off. Nothing is started or stopped until you arm it.
invalid_alert: Start and end are the same. Widen the window before arming does anything.
day_alert: Today is excluded. Sundial will wait for a selected weekday.
hold_alert: Next automatic start/stop is skipped. The hold clears after that moment.
quiet_in: Inside the quiet window — protection should stay off.
quiet_out: Outside the quiet window — protection may stay on.
guard_in: Inside the guard window — protection should stay on.
guard_out: Outside the guard window — protection should stay off.
reconnect_warn: App auto-reconnect is on. It may start protection again after Sundial pauses it. Turn that off if quiet hours should stick.
need_control: vpn.control was not granted. The clock can still show the window, but it cannot start or stop protection.
